edits.new:
Scenario: AC9 Rules with no other criterion hold on every run (new in this story)
    Given the suite is run against the wave 1 contracts in SIT
    When the suite makes its assertions and calls
    Then every assertion is made on a contract response or an event, each call is one hop with a 2 s client budget, the event is a CloudEvents 1.0 type keyed caseId, and the age bands and expected totals come from the fixture files

  Scenario: AC10 Duplicate delivery of a consumed event (new in this story)

edits.old: Then the retry or the timeout is recorded on the run record
edits.new:
Then the retry or the timeout is recorded on the run record

  Scenario: AC12 Consumed call fails or does not answer (new in this story)
    Given a consumed call of this service is made for a business date
    When the call fails or does not answer within its 2 s client budget
    Then the criterion fails and the failure is recorded on the run record

  Scenario: AC13 Status change the model does not allow is refused (new in this story)
    Given a status change that the status model does not allow is requested for a business date
    When the change is submitted
    Then the change is refused and the status is unchanged
